notes.title: Notice of release of Korean version
notes.content:
[h3]We’re Ready to Welcome a New Generation of Polylylyrhythmic Humans — Now with Korean Language Support![/h3]

[list]
[*] Korean Language Support
That’s right — Polylylyrhythm is now fully available in Korean!
An incredibly dedicated volunteer translator suddenly appeared out of nowhere and took it upon themselves to translate every single one of the game’s absurdly numerous lines of text — all so that Korean players could enjoy the game more easily.
Massive thanks to Maris — a translater.

[*] Correction to Chinese Translation
The phrase “Move to Offset / Judgment Adjustment Screen” was previously mistranslated in Chinese. It has now been corrected to “偏移调整.”

[*] Achievement Description Fix
The achievement Polylylyrhythmic Offbeat was incorrectly displayed as poweeweeweezmic offbeat. This has now been fixed.

[*] Polylylyrimshot Terminology Adjustment
The phrase “Wait, 16 bars!?” didn’t quite make sense in context — it should’ve been “16 beats” instead. This has been corrected.

[*] Translation of Tuplets
The translation of “There are tuplets too!” had mistakenly been “There are rests too!” It has now been corrected to properly reference tuplets.

All of these errors were also spotted by the same volunteer translator.
Is it even fair to be blessed with someone this talented???

[*] Korean Promo Video & Press Release
While not directly part of the game, all Korean-facing promotional texts — including the upcoming trailer and press materials — have been fully translated by Maris.
Seriously, who lets a volunteer do this much?

[*] Color Fix for “Memorhythm” Success Judgment
The success color in the Memorhythm mode has been changed from gray to blue.
The gray was actually unintentional.
We suspect that literally no one besides the dev ever realized this was a bug.
[/list]

notes.title: アップデートのお知らせ（Ver.1.02）
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, Polyrhythm Humanity!
Here's an update on new features and bug fixes!
[/h3]

 [list]
[*] Added English and Chinese translations for Polylylylyrim Shot.
Did you miss seeing the creator's text?
Oh, not really?
 
[*] Adjusted the difficulty of Polylylytuplet.
[*] Tweaked the occurrence of tuplets in Polylylytuplet's random mode.
[*] Disabled triplet generation for large time signatures.
There was an issue where more tuplets appeared in random mode than the creator had intended.
Additionally, certain polyrhythms in random charts could momentarily exceed BPM 3000.
Since over a month has passed with zero clears, we have officially determined that this was a mode beyond human capability and have adjusted it accordingly.
We sincerely apologize, humanity.
Note: There are no plans to adjust the difficulty of "Polymemorhythmic Offbeat" which also has zero clears. We eagerly await the birth of the ultimate polyrhythm human.

[*] Sped up the screen transition effects on the title screen.
A good tempo is always better, right?

[*] Added a retry button in practice mode to replay the last played mode.
Why didn’t we implement such a useful feature earlier?

[*] Added an option to disable the "screen flashing effect" in general settings.
[*] Added an option to disable "effect display" in general settings.
This completely nullifies the creator’s little graphical tricks and improves performance.

[*] Added an option to turn off the first beat sound in practice mode.
[*] Added an option to disable title BGM in audio settings.
Pretty handy, isn't it?
 
[*] Fixed a bug where the same drum pattern appeared twice in "Polylylyrim Shot".
[*] Corrected the English achievement name for "Ample Rest".
Please forgive us. It was a careless mistake.

Enjoy the update! 🚀
[/list]

notes.title: ver 1.01 update
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "Polylylyrhythm."
We have released an update today with the following fixes and improvements:

[h3]Update Details[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a game-breaking bug.
[*]Resolved issues with achievements.
[*]Corrected the name and condition display for the "polyplet" achievement.
[*]Fixed the issue preventing the "Fascinating Rhythm" achievement from unlocking correctly.
[*]Resolved combo-sharing issues.
[*]Fixed a problem where combos were being shared across different modes.
[*]Improved the user interface on the Game Over screen.
[*]Fixed rendering bugs on the Results screen.
[*]Corrected an issue with combo count recording when achieving a perfect clear.
[/list]

This update is aimed at providing an even smoother and more enjoyable gaming experience.

We appreciate your continued support of "Polylylyrhythm" and welcome your feedback and suggestions as we continue to improve the game.

Please update to the latest version and enjoy the enhanced experience!

notes.title: Polylylyrhythm Now Available!
notes.content:
[h2]Release Announcement for Polylylyrhythm[/h2]
Polylylyrhythm is now available on Steam as of Saturday, December 7, following the conclusion of Indie Live Expo! The game supports three languages: Japanese, Simplified Chinese, and English.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038114/11e48f12afa75ef2aebd76643a46f331f543b694.jpg[/img]

The full version includes exciting new modes, such as the Jacob Collier Challenge+ and Polylylyrim Shot, among many others!

[h2]Comments from the Developers[/h2]
[b]Namari[/b]
The game we thought no one could clear has been conquered by superhumans! Now, we’re raising the stakes with enhanced volume and quality.

We’re delivering a rhythm experience unlike anything you’ve ever seen!

[b]Sunajiro[/b]
I'm Sunajiro, the sound designer for Polylylyrhythm!
With the addition of numerous modes, the game has been upgraded to a deluxe edition. Please immerse yourself in the mesmerizing world woven by multiple rhythms and enjoy it to your heart's content!
What? It's too difficult? I completely agree with you!!!　

[h2]A Mind-Disrupting Experience: Welcome to Polylylyrhythm![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038114/b89746d84a5ed486fff98a6e6b128b255d6ed752.png[/img]
It’s a simple game—just press the corresponding key when a ◯ reaches the vertices of the shapes!
Well... the number of shapes will gradually increase, though...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038114/e2169fbdf1401f30b54127e5b0b4cf6cca0b1fdf.png[/img]
Explore complex modes like Rest Mode and Offbeat Mode in Stage Select!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038114/9a4700553c7ad36b27229610725e37207c09dba9.png[/img]
Smash through five random polyrhythms simultaneously and aim to become the ultimate [b]Polyrhythm Human[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038114/699d917e921261230ad5c001e7e92427c736923e.png[/img]
[b]New Mode: Polylylyrhythm Shot![/b]
Experience mixed rests, tuplets, and offbeats! Play infinite charts generated globally!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038114/cafbfc210fdc3b4c02631fa425a30c18b5fe7033.png[/img]
Master the 10-Finger Technique
[b]Jacob Collier+[/b]
If you can handle this, you’ve truly become a Polyrhythm Human.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038114/d000f4635ea955c05ad92cf068ce2f2763407904.png[/img]
[b]Revamped Results Screen![/b]
Compete with friends and players worldwide in rhythm rankings!

notes.title: Demo Version Just Got an Update! (Ver.1.01)
notes.content:
Hello, fellow Polylylyrhythm enthusiasts!

We've got a fresh update for the demo version, bringing new features and bug fixes! 🎉

Added extremely personalized credit text Um… are we even allowed to do this? 😂

Fixed an issue where the practice rest mode text wasn't displaying correctly in Chinese

Resolved an issue where Chinese tweets were showing up as garbled text Chinese support is seriously tough… we’re low-key sobbing over here 😭

Stage select screen now supports arrow keys and WASD controls

Fixed an issue where the arrow keys and WASD were messing with the judgment adjustment screen, making it hard to fine-tune settings Improved control experience! Time to crank up that polyrhythm production line! 🏭

Unified hashtags on X (formerly known as Twitter) in English Polylylyrhythm is ready to take over the world… soon™️.

Fixed an issue where effects became overwhelming at high-speed play So, a speed demon cleared the 3x mode two days after the demo went live. 

He told me, “Dude, the effects are kinda in the way.” My bad, we weren’t quite ready for players of that caliber. 😅
